def process(variantsTable) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    target = 'HPKPEVLGSSADGALLVSLDGLR'

    df = variantsTable.copy()
    df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.columns]

    hit = df[df['Peptide'].astype(str).str.strip() == target].copy()

    if hit.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame({'Peptide_found': [False], 'Samples_With_Peptide': [None]})

    # Samples_With_Peptide may be a semicolon/comma/space separated string; normalize to individual sample IDs
    samples_str = hit['Samples_With_Peptide'].dropna().astype(str).tolist()
    # keep original row(s) for traceability
    out = hit[['Peptide', 'Samples_With_Peptide', 'Num_Samples_With_Peptide', 'Gene', 'Variant_Type', 'Variant']].copy()

    # explode to sample IDs
    all_samples = []
    for s in samples_str:
        # common delimiters
        parts = [p.strip() for p in s.replace(',', ';').replace('|', ';').split(';')]
        parts = [p for p in parts if p]
        all_samples.extend(parts)

    out2 = pd.DataFrame({'Peptide': [target] * len(all_samples), 'Proteomics_Participant_ID': all_samples})
    out2 = out2.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)

    # attach variant info (may be multiple; keep first for context)
    context = out.head(1).drop(columns=['Samples_With_Peptide']).to_dict('records')[0]
    for k, v in context.items():
        out2[k] = v

    return out2

def process(variantsTable) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    target = 'HPKPEVLGSSADGALLVSLDGLR'

    df = variantsTable.copy()
    df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.columns]

    # normalize peptide string for robust matching
    pep = df['Peptide'].astype(str).str.strip()

    exact = df[pep == target].copy()
    contains = df[pep.str.contains(target, na=False)].copy()
    # also search with I/L ambiguity common in proteomics
    alt = target.replace('I', '[IL]').replace('L', '[IL]')
    regex = df[pep.str.contains(alt, na=False, regex=True)].copy()

    def pack(name, sub):
        if sub.empty:
            return pd.DataFrame([{'match_type': name, 'n_rows': 0, 'samples_concat': None}])
        return pd.DataFrame([{
            'match_type': name,
            'n_rows': len(sub),
            'samples_concat': ';'.join(sorted(set(sub['Samples_With_Peptide'].dropna().astype(str))))
        }])

    out = pd.concat([pack('exact', exact), pack('contains', contains), pack('IL_regex', regex)], ignore_index=True)
    return out

    # Expand Samples_With_Peptide -> one row per sample
    samp = ca['Samples_With_Peptide'].astype(str).str.replace('|', ',', regex=False)

    for s in samp:
